systems.name: CompCert 3.18
systems.person_years: 6 PY initial (v1.3 PowerPC, 2005-2008); ~18-22 PY cumulative across x86/ARM/RISC-V/AArch64
systems.generated_code_perf: ~90-93% of gcc -O1, ~85-88% of gcc -O2, ~78-82% of gcc -O3 on SPECint/MiBench
systems.validator_compile_overhead: RTL/Linear/Mach translation validators add 6-14% to total compile time
systems.post_verification_bugs: Yang et al. PLDI 2011 (Csmith): 0 middle-end bugs; ~11 bugs in unverified C2C front-end/elaborator and target assembly emission/ABI boundaries (va_arg, bitfields, struct passing)

systems.name: CompCert-KVX / Chamois-CompCert (BTL)
systems.generated_code_perf: +12% to +28% over mainline CompCert via BTL superblock scheduling, software pipelining, and peephole bundles on Kalray KVX / AArch64 / RISC-V
systems.validator_compile_overhead: BTL symbolic simulation validator adds ~8-15% compile time
systems.post_verification_bugs: Unverified oracle bugs caught by BTL validator return Error rather than miscompiling; assembly-level VLIW bundle resource hazards outside Asm semantics required separate hardware checking

systems.name: CompCertSSA
systems.generated_code_perf: Parity with CompCert + SSA-based GVN/SCCP (+2-4% on scalar loops)
systems.validator_compile_overhead: Dominance + SSA well-formedness validator adds ~4-7% compile time
systems.post_verification_bugs: None reported in verified SSA middle-end; maintenance stalled due to divergence from mainline CompCert RTL evolution

systems.name: CompCertO
systems.person_years: ~3 PY incremental over CompCert (Yale FLINT, POPL 2021)
systems.generated_code_perf: Identical to underlying CompCert 3.7/3.9 back-end
systems.validator_compile_overhead: Identical to CompCert
systems.post_verification_bugs: Exposed compositional call-convention and memory-injection non-transitivity edge cases in CompCert's closed-world whole-program theorem

systems.name: CakeML
systems.team_size: 6-10 contributors across Chalmers, UNSW, ANU, Kent, Cambridge
systems.generated_code_perf: Within 1.5x-3.0x of MLton / OCaml native on pure FP benchmarks; 12 intermediate IRs with verified GC and register allocator
systems.validator_compile_overhead: In-logic proof-producing bootstrap takes ~10-18 hours in HOL4; extracted native compiler runs at normal compiler speed with 0 runtime proof overhead
systems.post_verification_bugs: FFI boundary and OS wrapper bugs in unverified C shims; HOL4 kernel/loader bugs studied via Candle verified kernel

systems.name: seL4 (L4.verified + graph-refine binary TV)
systems.person_years: 20 PY initial functional correctness (11 PY seL4, 9 PY frameworks, SOSP 2009) + ~4 PY binary TV (PLDI 2013); >60 PY cumulative across AArch64/RISC-V/x86-64/MCS
systems.generated_code_perf: Compiled with gcc -O2 (verified via graph-refine on ARMv7/RISC-V); IPC fastpath within 10% of unverified L4 microkernels
systems.validator_compile_overhead: graph-refine SMT binary validation requires ~20-90 CPU-minutes for the full ~10k LOC kernel image at gcc -O2
systems.post_verification_bugs: 0 bugs in verified C paths under stated hypotheses; bugs found in unverified boot/assembly init, MMU/TLB cache-maintenance assumptions, and unverified platform configuration scripts

systems.name: Vellvm (VIR / ITree)
systems.generated_code_perf: Semantic specification and reference interpreter for LLVM IR (mem2reg / Helix lowering verified); uses stock LLVM backend for codegen
systems.validator_compile_overhead: Extracted OCaml VIR interpreter runs small-to-medium LLVM IR unit tests (~10^3-10^4 instructions/sec)
systems.post_verification_bugs: Uncovered undef/poison/pointer-cast ambiguities in the LLVM Language Reference Manual

systems.name: Crellvm
systems.generated_code_perf: Instruments stock LLVM 3.8 GVN, SROA, LICM, InstCombine (-O2 parity on supported functions)
systems.validator_compile_overhead: Hint generation adds ~12% to LLVM compile time; Coq/OCaml relational validator adds ~15-60x compile time (~1.2s per function)
systems.post_verification_bugs: Found 5 miscompilations in LLVM 3.8 (GVN, LICM, InstCombine) where validator rejected LLVM's transformation

systems.name: Alive2
systems.generated_code_perf: Validates unmodified LLVM -O2/-O3 passes directly
systems.validator_compile_overhead: SMT query takes ~50 ms to 60 s per function (timeout rate ~8-18% on complex loop/memory functions in LLVM test suite)
systems.post_verification_bugs: Has found >100 confirmed LLVM miscompilation bugs; Alive2 itself is unverified C++ + Z3 (occasional SMT encoding bugs fixed in Alive2 commits)

systems.name: Cranelift ISLE & Crocus Verification
systems.person_years: ~2.5 PY for Crocus verification (ASPLOS 2024); ~25+ PY for Cranelift overall
systems.generated_code_perf: Cranelift -O2 achieves ~70-85% of LLVM -O2 runtime speed while compiling ~2-4x faster
systems.validator_compile_overhead: Offline SMT rule verification (0 runtime compile overhead)
systems.post_verification_bugs: Crocus found 3 instruction-lowering bugs and multiple under-constrained bitwidth preconditions in Cranelift x64/aarch64 ISLE rules

systems.name: regalloc2 & Symbolic Checker
systems.generated_code_perf: Ion SSA allocator matches LLVM greedy allocator within ~3-6% code quality
systems.validator_compile_overhead: checker.rs symbolic dataflow checker adds ~15-25% to register allocation time (~2-4% of total Cranelift compile time)
systems.post_verification_bugs: Fuzzing regalloc2 with checker.rs enabled caught parallel-move cycle and spill-slot conflict bugs before production deployment; checker itself is unverified Rust

systems.name: Jasmin Compiler

systems.validator_compile_overhead: Extracted OCaml compiler with verified passes + linear-scan register allocation validation (<1s per crypto primitive)
systems.post_verification_bugs: Unverified assembly printer and hardware microarchitectural leakage assumptions outside architectural constant-time model

systems.name: Vale (Verified Assembly Language for Everest)
systems.generated_code_perf: Outperforms OpenSSL handwritten x64/AVX2/AES-NI assembly on AES-GCM and Poly1305
systems.validator_compile_overhead: F* Z3 + normalizer verification takes minutes per primitive at build time; 0 runtime overhead
systems.post_verification_bugs: Found a carry-flag clobber bug in OpenSSL's Poly1305 x64 implementation; relies on unverified ISA operational axioms and Z3/F*

systems.name: Fiat Cryptography

systems.name: Bedrock2

systems.validator_compile_overhead: Syntax-directed RegAlloc.v and FitsStack.v checkers run inside Coq reduction
